reuse.why: Follows the existing assertNotLinkedElsewhere guard pattern and hooks into the two existing link entry points (GoCardless and the shared linkSyncServerAccount) that every provider already goes through.

duplication.why: One new guard, called twice; no logic is copied.

placement.why: The guard sits beside the other link preconditions in accounts/app.ts and runs before any write or sync-server call.

scope.why: Only the guard, its two calls and a release note.

maintainability.why: A small named precondition next to its sibling; a maintainer would hardly notice it needed owning.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both provider paths call the new guard through the existing shared link functions; nothing goes around them.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts assertNotClosed is the single definition of the closed-account rule, called from linkGoCardlessAccount and linkSyncServerAccount, which together cover all providers.
